ValidationRule.description: Restrict Specialist Lenders from editing Disputes/general Enquiry cases if not owned by them.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(ISNEW()), $Permission.ANZx_Specialist_Lender, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ATM_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'BPAY_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_Debit_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_Entry_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'NPP_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IMT_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'PayTo_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'General_Inquiry', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Feedback', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Case_Group' ) )
